description: This Java class 'LiteralUpdate' provides mechanisms for creating and managing updates of uncompressed data (DData) within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating empty updates, replacing all data, and taking snapshots of the current state.

classes.name: LiteralUpdate
classes.description: A final class that extends 'AbstractIndelUpdate' to manage updates containing sets of insertions and deletions of strings, with support for immutability and snapshot operations.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates and returns an empty, non-replaceable LiteralUpdate instance.

methods.name: replaceAll
methods.description: Creates a LiteralUpdate that replaces all existing data with the specified set of inserts.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot copy of the current LiteralUpdate instance, including current inserts and deletes.
